China has fewer people than India, but it is much bigger in land area. China's National Bureau of Statistics put its population at about 1.405 billion at the end of 2025. That was down 3.39 million from the year before, the fourth year in a row that it shrank [1][2]. India passed China as the most populous country in 2023 and has around 1.43 billion people or more. By land area, though, China covers about 9.6 million km², nearly three times India's roughly 3.29 million km².

Sources:
[1] Statistical Communiqué of the People's Republic of China on the 2025 National Economic and Social Development – https://www.stats.gov.cn/english/PressRelease/202602/t20260228_1962661.html
[2] China's population declines for a fourth straight year amid record low births (ABC News) – https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-01-20/china-population-decline-fourth-straight-year/106245406
